title: CityInterestDocument
description: Waitlist interest in one city: how many different people asked to hear when it opens, in all and by UTC day. cityInterest/in-mh-pune for a catalog city, cityInterest/other-in for cities the catalog does not have in a country (other-xx with no country). joinWaitlist counts a person once per city through cityInterestMarkers; adminGetCityInterest reads it.
x-owner: Functions joinWaitlist (website launch notice) and tool/data/backfill_city_interest.mjs

cityId.description: The market catalog id, or null for the country's Other.

daily.description: First requests by UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD). A missing day is zero.
